ja: 文武両道を極めた轟の参謀“周瑜ヒャクシキ”がBB戦士にラインナップ 武器は背中のバインダーを組み合わせた弓とクリアパーツの矢、大剣が付属 弓、矢、刀、バックパックを専用パーツに装着すれば、大型武器メガバズーカランチャーが再現可能 通常の瞳に加え、バイザーを付けた状態の瞳シールも付属
en: Shuyu Hyakushiki, Todoroki's staff who has mastered both literary and martial arts, is now available as a BB warrior. Weapons include a bow combined with the binder on his back, arrows with clear parts, and a large sword. By attaching the bow, arrow, sword, and backpack to the special parts, you can recreate the large weapon Mega Bazooka Launcher. In addition to the regular eyes, an eye seal with a visor attached is also included.
